scope: all sixteen existing contexts, both banks, all-block H3-only and repeated patches; no new model calls
metric: reference cost of candidate selected by patch minus minimum reference cost
relative_metric: 100 times excess reference cost divided by minimum reference cost; undefined for nonpositive minimum
aggregation: retain all32 banks; task/bank mean and median across eight contexts; no new significance tests or favorable selection
purpose: measure size of disagreements behind17/32, not simulator regret or task success
